properties.description:
FFWLZK

The National Weather Service in Little Rock has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Perry County in central Arkansas...
Southwestern Pope County in central Arkansas...
Central Yell County in central Arkansas...
East Central Logan County in western Arkansas...

* Until 830 AM CDT.

heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain

small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route over
higher ground.

enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
